header: Reasons on one side, figures on the other
lead: For figures that need an argument next to them.
bodytext:
Astryx for TYPO3 has moved fast and kept its shape. Fifteen releases in eight weeks, and what each release is checked against stayed small: four layers of components, four breakpoints that every element shares and two languages for every label.

A switch swaps the two halves. In the source order the text always comes first, because figures without context are just a list of numbers.
note: Releases counted from 1.0.0 on 6 August to 2.4.0 on 28 September 2026.
